blocks.title: Welcome to Triangles
blocks.body: Before we dive in, let's look at a real-life example of this concept.
blocks.body_hi: इससे पहले कि हम शुरू करें, आइए इस अवधारणा का एक वास्तविक जीवन उदाहरण देखें।

blocks.title: Example 1
blocks.body: In a right triangle, the two legs are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse.
blocks.body_hi: In a right triangle, the two legs are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse.

blocks.title: Example 2
blocks.body: A ladder 10 m long reaches a window 8 m above the ground. Find the distance of the foot of the ladder from the wall.
blocks.body_hi: A ladder 10 m long reaches a window 8 m above the ground. Find the distance of the foot of the ladder from the wall.

blocks.title: Example 3
blocks.body: Check if a triangle with sides 7 cm, 24 cm, 25 cm is a right triangle. Give (hypotenuse)² − (sum of other squares) [should be 0 if right triangle].
blocks.body_hi: Check if a triangle with sides 7 cm, 24 cm, 25 cm is a right triangle. Give (hypotenuse)² − (sum of other squares) [should be 0 if right triangle].

blocks.title: Example 4
blocks.body: In triangle ABC, DE ∥ BC. If AD=3, AB=9, AC=12, find AE.
blocks.body_hi: In triangle ABC, DE ∥ BC. If AD=3, AB=9, AC=12, find AE.

blocks.title: Example 5
blocks.body: A 6 m tall pole casts a shadow of 8 m. Find the length of the hypotenuse (top of pole to tip of shadow) using Pythagoras.
blocks.body_hi: A 6 m tall pole casts a shadow of 8 m. Find the length of the hypotenuse (top of pole to tip of shadow) using Pythagoras.
